texts.title: My first job interview
texts.text: Last Monday I had my first job interview at a big IT company. I was very nervous, so I arrived thirty minutes early. The manager was friendly. She asked me about my experience and my skills. I told her that I have worked with computers for three years. Then she asked a difficult question: why should we choose you? I said that I learn fast and I am not afraid of hard tasks. Two days later they called me. I got the job! I am going to start next month.

texts.title: Fixing an old house
texts.text: My uncle bought an old house near the river. The roof was broken and the pipes were very old, so we decided to repair everything ourselves. First we checked the foundation, and it was still strong. Then we changed the pipes and the wires. It was dirty and heavy work, but we didn't stop. My uncle has already painted the walls, and next week we are going to put in new windows. The house is going to be warmer and cheaper to heat.

questions.q: Что было не так с домом?

texts.title: A trip that went wrong
texts.text: Last summer I flew to Barcelona. At the airport there was a four-hour delay, so I read a book and drank a lot of coffee. When I finally arrived, my luggage wasn't there! The airline said it was still in Moscow. I had to buy new clothes and a toothbrush. The next day my bag arrived at the hotel. In the end, the trip was great: I went sightseeing, swam in the sea and met friendly people. Next time I will take only a small bag.

questions.q: Что автор сделает в следующий раз?

texts.title: Our online tournament
texts.text: This weekend my team played in an online tournament. There were sixty-four teams, and the prize was five hundred dollars. Before the first match we practised for three hours. Our first two games were easy, but in the third game the enemy attacked very fast. Our best player had a lag, and we almost lost. In the end we won, but in the semi-final we lost to a stronger team. We are not sad: we have learned a lot, and we are going to play again next month.
